entities.name: Grist
entities.description: An insect planeswalker from an undisclosed plane whose essence inhabits insect swarms.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who noticed the insect plagues and sought out Ajani.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who found and spoke with Grist.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane ravaged by Grist; its Wilds are where Grist is relocated to feed.

entities.name: Mossverge
entities.description: A hurting village whose fields Grist threatened.

events.summary: Tamiyo seeks out Ajani Goldmane to solve the mystery of the flashes before and after insect plagues.
events.quote: sought out Ajani Goldmane to help her solve the mystery of the flashes

events.summary: Ajani searches the swarm, discovers Grist and speaks with her.
events.quote: Ajani searched the swarm for a soul with a spark and, in doing so, discovered and spoke with Grist.

events.summary: Tamiyo suggests Grist feed on the Wilds of Eldraine instead of Mossverge's fields, and Grist agrees.
events.quote: Grist agreed to relocate the feast

relations.note: Ajani and Tamiyo consider Grist a friend for now.
relations.quote: For now, Grist is a friend.
